Hi Emily — thanks, really glad the initial run was useful. We can accommodate both asks; below are two concrete options so Procurement can pick. I've attached a short pricing summary and a proposed MSA addendum template for the PHI sandbox.

Option A — Timebox extension (6 weeks)
- 6 additional weeks with same runtime profile
- One-time fee: $28,000 (equivalent to ~500K tokens of sustained load)
- Discount: 15% off list for the extension if signed within 5 business days
- Deliverable: shared VPC endpoint with KMS integration (PHI-enabled) available within 3 business days of addendum execution

Option B — Credit bundle + conversion path
- Buy a $35,000 credit bundle (usable during extension)
- If NeonHealth converts to a 6-month Dedicated commit within 60 days, apply an additional 10% credit back (effective ~25% off incremental consumption)
- PHI sandbox available as add-on at $2,500 one-time setup (waived with immediate Dedicated commit)

Notes/assumptions
- PHI sandbox: customer-managed keys or Redwood-managed KMS (customer to confirm preference)
- We’ll need the signed MSA addendum and a short scoping doc for the two engineers who need access
- Attachments: neonhealth_pricing_summary.pdf (price breakout), neonhealth_mop_v2.xlsx (usage assumptions), MSA_Addendum_NeonHealth.docx

If Procurement prefers a firm percent, we can offer a one-time 20% reduction on Option A with a signed addendum and PO. Happy to jump on a quick call to finalize.

Thanks,
